title: [L3LS] MAC learning failure — DC1 leaf1b VLAN 11
symptom: Hosts in VLAN 11 on dc1-leaf1b are reachable locally but cannot be reached from dc1-leaf1a or dc1-leaf2a. BGP sessions appear healthy. Triage using L3LS orchestrator.
root_cause: redistribute learned removed from router bgp 65101 vlan 11 on dc1-leaf1b — local MACs not advertised as EVPN Type-2 routes
